name: Gap Reads & Finishing
summary: Warm up your handle, read gaps between defenders, then finish at the rim through jump stops and tired attack rounds.

drills.name: Two-Speed Lane Dribbles
drills.summary: Wake up your hands by switching between slow control and fast pushes.
steps: Start on the baseline at the edge of the lane.
Walk to the free-throw line with low, hard dribbles.
Speed up to a run from the free-throw line to half court.
Turn and come back the same way with your other hand.
Switch hands every trip and keep the ball off your hip.

drills.name: Two-Cone Gap Reads
drills.summary: Read the space between two defenders and pick the right answer fast.
steps: Set two cones at the top of the key as defenders.
Move them close together or far apart before each rep.
Attack from half court and look at the gap early.
Big gap: split it and drive to the rim.
Small gap: stop, pull back two dribbles and pass to the wall.
Change the gap every rep so you can't guess.

drills.name: Jump-Stop Pivot Finishes
drills.summary: Stop on balance in the paint, then pivot to an open finish.
steps: Drive from the wing with two hard dribbles.
Land a two-foot jump stop just outside the block.
Pivot away from an imaginary help defender.
Finish off the glass with the hand away from the help.
Do 5 reps on each side, then switch which foot you pivot on.

drills.name: Four-Spot Attack Rounds
drills.summary: Attack from four spots in a row and finish strong while tired.
steps: Put cones in both corners and on both wings.
Start at one corner, drive baseline and finish.
Grab the rebound and sprint the ball out to the next cone.
Attack from that cone with a different move each time.
Keep going around all four cones for 60 seconds.
Rest 30 seconds and run 4 rounds total.
